name: DiPtera
source:
Join Lucilia on her journey of self-growth as she learns to fly while being chased by the expectations of her mother, the harsh competition of her rival (Tia, The Mosquito), and her own self-realization of what she has become.

[From [url=https://dlm-interactive-studios.itch.io/diptera]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
与露西莉亚一起踏上她的自我成长之旅，她一边学习飞行，一边被母亲的期望、竞争对手（蒂亚、蚊子）的残酷竞争以及她自己对自己的自我认识所追赶。

[来自[url=https://dlm-interactive-studios.itch.io/diptera]itch.io[/url]]
